from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.fuse.backend.default import DefaultFuseOp
from mirage.fuse.backend.memory import MemoryFuseOp
from mirage.types import MountMode
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def test_default_eager_small_file():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/f.txt", b"hello world")
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/f.txt", 11)
    assert ctx["eager"] is True
    data = op.read(ws, "/f.txt", 0, 5, ctx)
    assert data == b"hello"


def test_default_lazy_large_file():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    big = b"x" * (2 * 1024 * 1024)
    ws.write("/big.bin", big)
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/big.bin", len(big))
    assert ctx["eager"] is False
    chunk = op.read(ws, "/big.bin", 0, 100, ctx)
    assert chunk == b"x" * 100


def test_memory_always_eager():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    big = b"y" * (2 * 1024 * 1024)
    ws.write("/big.bin", big)
    op = MemoryFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/big.bin", len(big))
    assert ctx["eager"] is True


def test_buffered_write_flush():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/f.txt", b"hello world")
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/f.txt", 11)
    op.write(ws, "/f.txt", 0, b"HELLO", ctx)
    op.write(ws, "/f.txt", 6, b"WORLD", ctx)
    op.on_flush(ws, "/f.txt", ctx)
    assert ws.cat("/f.txt") == b"HELLO WORLD"


def test_buffered_write_new_file():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/new.txt", 0)
    op.write(ws, "/new.txt", 0, b"brand new", ctx)
    op.on_flush(ws, "/new.txt", ctx)
    assert ws.cat("/new.txt") == b"brand new"


def test_flush_noop_without_writes():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/f.txt", b"original")
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/f.txt", 8)
    op.on_flush(ws, "/f.txt", ctx)
    assert ws.cat("/f.txt") == b"original"

import os
import tempfile

import pytest

from mirage.fuse.loader import build_registry_from_config, load_fuse_op_class


def test_load_builtin_module():
    cls = load_fuse_op_class("mirage.fuse.backend.default:DefaultFuseOp")
    op = cls()
    assert op.name == "default"


def test_load_from_file():
    code = ("from mirage.fuse import FuseOp\n"
            "class CustomOp(FuseOp):\n"
            "    name = 'custom_test'\n")
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".py", mode="w",
                                     delete=False) as f:
        f.write(code)
        f.flush()
        cls = load_fuse_op_class(f"{f.name}:CustomOp")
    op = cls()
    assert op.name == "custom_test"
    os.unlink(f.name)


def test_invalid_spec():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="invalid"):
        load_fuse_op_class("no_colon_here")


def test_build_registry_builtin():
    registry = build_registry_from_config({"*.parquet": "default"})
    op = registry.resolve("/data/file.parquet", 100)
    assert op.name == "default"


def test_build_registry_custom_class():
    registry = build_registry_from_config({
        "*.txt":
        "mirage.fuse.backend.memory:MemoryFuseOp",
    })
    op = registry.resolve("/data/file.txt", 100)
    assert op.name == "memory"


def test_build_registry_dict_form():
    registry = build_registry_from_config({
        "*.bin": {
            "handler": "s3"
        },
    })
    op = registry.resolve("/data/file.bin", 100)
    assert op.name == "s3"


def test_build_registry_empty():
    registry = build_registry_from_config({})
    op = registry.resolve("/data/file.txt", 100)
    assert op.name == "default"

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from mirage.backend.object_storage.r2 import R2Config
from mirage.backend.object_storage.s3 import S3Config
from mirage.commands.custom.registry import ExternalCommand


def test_s3config_defaults():
    c = S3Config(bucket="my-bucket")
    assert c.region is None
    assert c.timeout == 30
    assert c.select_threshold_bytes == 1024 * 1024


def test_s3config_immutable():
    c = S3Config(bucket="x")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        c.bucket = "y"


def test_r2config_fields():
    c = R2Config(account_id="acc",
                 bucket="bkt",
                 access_key_id="k",
                 secret_access_key="s")
    assert c.region == "auto"
    assert c.timeout == 30


def test_r2config_immutable():
    c = R2Config(account_id="a",
                 bucket="b",
                 access_key_id="k",
                 secret_access_key="s")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        c.bucket = "other"


def test_external_command_fields():
    cmd = ExternalCommand(name="linecount", exec="python lc.py {file}")
    assert cmd.description == ""


def test_external_command_immutable():
    cmd = ExternalCommand(name="x", exec="echo {file}")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        cmd.name = "y"

import io

import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.fuse.filetype.csv import CsvFuseOp
from mirage.fuse.filetype.parquet import ParquetFuseOp
from mirage.types import MountMode
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def _make_parquet_bytes() -> bytes:
    table = pa.table({
        "name": ["alice", "bob", "charlie"],
        "score": [95, 87, 72],
    })
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    pq.write_table(table, buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def test_parquet_read_returns_text():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/data.parquet", _make_parquet_bytes())
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/data.parquet", 1000)
    data = op.read(ws, "/data.parquet", 0, 4096, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "name" in text
    assert "score" in text
    assert "alice" in text


def test_parquet_schema_in_output():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/data.parquet", _make_parquet_bytes())
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/data.parquet", 1000)
    data = op.read(ws, "/data.parquet", 0, 8192, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "int" in text.lower()


def test_parquet_row_count():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/data.parquet", _make_parquet_bytes())
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/data.parquet", 1000)
    data = op.read(ws, "/data.parquet", 0, 8192, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "Rows: 3" in text


def test_parquet_error_handling():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/bad.parquet", b"not a parquet file")
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/bad.parquet", 18)
    data = op.read(ws, "/bad.parquet", 0, 4096, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "Error" in text


def test_csv_small_passthrough():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    small = b"name,score\nalice,95\nbob,87\n"
    ws.write("/small.csv", small)
    op = CsvFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/small.csv", len(small))
    data = op.read(ws, "/small.csv", 0, 4096, ctx)
    assert data == small


def test_csv_large_preview():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    header = "name,score\n"
    rows = "".join(f"user{i},{i}\n" for i in range(5000))
    big = (header + rows).encode()
    ws.write("/big.csv", big)
    op = CsvFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/big.csv", len(big))
    data = op.read(ws, "/big.csv", 0, 8192, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "name" in text
    assert "score" in text
    assert "5001 rows" in text
    assert "2 columns" in text


def test_csv_large_has_preview_marker():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    header = "a,b,c\n"
    rows = "".join(f"{i},{i+1},{i+2}\n" for i in range(5000))
    big = (header + rows).encode()
    ws.write("/big.csv", big)
    op = CsvFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/big.csv", len(big))
    data = op.read(ws, "/big.csv", 0, 8192, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "more rows" in text

import sys
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

import pytest

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.commands.custom.registry import CommandRegistry, ExternalCommand
from mirage.commands.remote.client import CommandClient
from mirage.types import (CommandResult, MountMode, RemoteCommandOptions,
                          SyncPolicy)
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def test_builtin_ls():
    ws = Workspace({"/tmp/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/tmp/a.txt", b"hi")
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    result = reg.run(ws, "ls /tmp/", cwd="/")
    assert "a.txt" in result


def test_register_external():
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    reg.register(ExternalCommand(name="echo-test", exec="echo hello"))
    assert "echo-test" in reg.list_commands()


def test_run_external_no_placeholder(tmp_path):
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    reg.register(ExternalCommand(name="greet", exec="echo hello"))
    ws = Workspace({"/tmp/": MemoryBackend()})
    result = reg.run(ws, "greet", cwd="/")
    assert "hello" in result


def test_run_external_file_placeholder(tmp_path):
    ws = Workspace({"/tmp/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/tmp/data.txt", b"line1\nline2")
    script = tmp_path / "count.py"
    script.write_text(
        "import sys; lines = open(sys.argv[1]).readlines(); print(len(lines))")
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    reg.register(
        ExternalCommand(name="linecount", exec=f"{sys.executable} {script}"))
    result = reg.run(ws, "linecount /tmp/data.txt", cwd="/")
    assert result.strip() == "2"


def test_unknown_command():
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    ws = Workspace({"/tmp/": MemoryBackend()})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unknown command"):
        reg.run(ws, "nonexistent", cwd="/")


def test_run_external_file_placeholder_multi_arg(tmp_path):
    ws = Workspace({"/tmp/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/tmp/a.txt", b"aaa")
    ws.write("/tmp/b.txt", b"bbb")
    script = tmp_path / "concat.py"
    script.write_text(
        "import sys; [print(open(f).read(), end='') for f in sys.argv[1:]]")
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    reg.register(
        ExternalCommand(name="concat", exec=f"{sys.executable} {script}"))
    result = reg.run(ws, "concat /tmp/a.txt /tmp/b.txt", cwd="/")
    assert "aaa" in result
    assert "bbb" in result


def test_external_overrides_builtin():
    ws = Workspace({"/tmp/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/tmp/file.txt", b"data")
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    reg.register(ExternalCommand(name="ls", exec="echo overridden"))
    result = reg.run(ws, "ls /tmp/", cwd="/")
    assert "overridden" in result
    assert "file.txt" not in result


class _CustomMethodBackend(MemoryBackend):

    def lllll(self, path: str) -> str:
        return f"custom-result-for:{path}"

    def bytes_method(self, path: str) -> bytes:
        return b"raw-bytes"

    def list_method(self, path: str) -> list:
        return ["item1", "item2", "item3"]


def test_backend_method_fallback():
    backend = _CustomMethodBackend()
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": backend}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    result = reg.run(ws, "lllll /data/", cwd="/")
    assert "custom-result-for:" in result


def test_backend_method_fallback_bytes_coercion():
    backend = _CustomMethodBackend()
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": backend}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    result = reg.run(ws, "bytes_method /data/", cwd="/")
    assert result == "raw-bytes"


def test_backend_method_fallback_list_coercion():
    backend = _CustomMethodBackend()
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": backend}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    result = reg.run(ws, "list_method /data/", cwd="/")
    assert "item1\nitem2\nitem3" == result


def test_backend_private_method_rejected():
    backend = _CustomMethodBackend()
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": backend}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unknown command"):
        reg.run(ws, "_files /data/", cwd="/")


def test_list_commands_includes_builtins():
    registry = CommandRegistry()
    cmds = registry.list_commands()
    assert "ls" in cmds
    assert "cat" in cmds

def test_external_command_with_options():

    )

def test_registry_dispatches_to_client_with_files():
    mock_client = MagicMock(spec=CommandClient)
    mock_client.run.return_value = CommandResult(
        stdout="done",
        output_files={"/tmp/out.csv": b"result"},

                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)

    reg.register(ExternalCommand(
        name="transform",
        exec="transform",

    assert files["/tmp/input.json"].checksum is not None

    output = ws.cat("/tmp/out.csv")
    assert output == b"result"

import pytest

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.commands.custom.registry import CommandRegistry
from mirage.fuse.registry import FuseOpRegistry
from mirage.runtime import MemoryRuntime
from mirage.runtime.accessors.local import (LocalCommandsAccessor,
                                            LocalFuseOpsAccessor,
                                            LocalWorkspaceOpsAccessor)
from mirage.types import MountMode
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def _make_ws():
    return Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)


def test_local_commands_list():
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    acc = LocalCommandsAccessor(reg)
    cmds = acc.list()
    assert "ls" in cmds
    assert "cat" in cmds


def test_local_commands_register():
    reg = CommandRegistry()
    acc = LocalCommandsAccessor(reg)
    acc.register("myjq", "jq .")
    assert "myjq" in acc.list()


def test_local_fuse_ops_list():
    reg = FuseOpRegistry()
    acc = LocalFuseOpsAccessor(reg)
    ops = acc.list()
    assert any(o["pattern"] == "*" for o in ops)


def test_local_fuse_ops_register():
    reg = FuseOpRegistry()
    acc = LocalFuseOpsAccessor(reg)
    acc.register("*.parquet", "parquet")
    ops = acc.list()
    assert any(o["pattern"] == "*.parquet" for o in ops)


def test_local_fuse_ops_register_unknown():
    reg = FuseOpRegistry()
    acc = LocalFuseOpsAccessor(reg)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unknown handler"):
        acc.register("*.xyz", "nonexistent_handler_xyz")


def test_local_workspace_ops_status():
    ws = _make_ws()
    acc = LocalWorkspaceOpsAccessor(ws)
    result = acc.status()
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_local_workspace_ops_sync():
    ws = _make_ws()
    acc = LocalWorkspaceOpsAccessor(ws)
    result = acc.sync()
    assert isinstance(result, list)


def test_local_workspace_ops_status_after_write():
    ws = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/f.txt", b"hello")
    acc = LocalWorkspaceOpsAccessor(ws)
    result = acc.status()
    paths = [s["path"] for s in result]
    assert "/f.txt" in paths


def test_runtime_has_accessors():
    ws = _make_ws()
    rt = MemoryRuntime(ws)
    assert hasattr(rt, "commands")
    assert hasattr(rt, "fuse_ops")
    assert hasattr(rt, "workspace")
    assert "ls" in rt.commands.list()

    assert opts.cache == "enabled"

## Context

The `mirage/` source tree was recently reorganized into subpackages (`backend/local/`, `backend/network/`, `fuse/backend/`, etc.), but the `tests/` directory still has a flat structure that doesn't mirror the source layout. This plan reorganizes tests so each source file `mirage/a/b/c.py` has exactly one test file `tests/a/b/test_c.py`.

## Summary of Changes

- **15 pure moves** (git mv to new subdirectory)
- **3 renames** (test file name doesn't match source file name)
- **4 splits** (one test file covers multiple source files)
- **2 merges** (multiple test files cover one source file)
- **15 new `__init__.py`** files in new test subdirectories
- **1 directory removal** (`tests/types/`)

---

- Remove empty `tests/types/` directory

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.fuse.backend.default import DefaultFuseOp
from mirage.types import MountMode
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def test_default_eager_small_file():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/f.txt", b"hello world")
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/f.txt", 11)
    assert ctx["eager"] is True
    data = op.read(ws, "/f.txt", 0, 5, ctx)
    assert data == b"hello"


def test_default_lazy_large_file():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    big = b"x" * (2 * 1024 * 1024)
    ws.write("/big.bin", big)
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/big.bin", len(big))
    assert ctx["eager"] is False
    chunk = op.read(ws, "/big.bin", 0, 100, ctx)
    assert chunk == b"x" * 100


def test_buffered_write_flush():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/f.txt", b"hello world")
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/f.txt", 11)
    op.write(ws, "/f.txt", 0, b"HELLO", ctx)
    op.write(ws, "/f.txt", 6, b"WORLD", ctx)
    op.on_flush(ws, "/f.txt", ctx)
    assert ws.cat("/f.txt") == b"HELLO WORLD"


def test_buffered_write_new_file():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/new.txt", 0)
    op.write(ws, "/new.txt", 0, b"brand new", ctx)
    op.on_flush(ws, "/new.txt", ctx)
    assert ws.cat("/new.txt") == b"brand new"


def test_flush_noop_without_writes():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/f.txt", b"original")
    op = DefaultFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/f.txt", 8)
    op.on_flush(ws, "/f.txt", ctx)
    assert ws.cat("/f.txt") == b"original"

import io

import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.fuse.filetype.parquet import ParquetFuseOp
from mirage.types import MountMode
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def _make_parquet_bytes() -> bytes:
    table = pa.table({
        "name": ["alice", "bob", "charlie"],
        "score": [95, 87, 72],
    })
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    pq.write_table(table, buf)
    return buf.getvalue()


def test_parquet_read_returns_text():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/data.parquet", _make_parquet_bytes())
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/data.parquet", 1000)
    data = op.read(ws, "/data.parquet", 0, 4096, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "name" in text
    assert "score" in text
    assert "alice" in text


def test_parquet_schema_in_output():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/data.parquet", _make_parquet_bytes())
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/data.parquet", 1000)
    data = op.read(ws, "/data.parquet", 0, 8192, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "int" in text.lower()


def test_parquet_row_count():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/data.parquet", _make_parquet_bytes())
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/data.parquet", 1000)
    data = op.read(ws, "/data.parquet", 0, 8192, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "Rows: 3" in text


def test_parquet_error_handling():
    ws = Workspace({"/": MemoryBackend()}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
    ws.write("/bad.parquet", b"not a parquet file")
    op = ParquetFuseOp()
    ctx = op.on_open(ws, "/bad.parquet", 18)
    data = op.read(ws, "/bad.parquet", 0, 4096, ctx)
    text = data.decode()
    assert "Error" in text

    assert inode.checksum is None

    assert inode.dirty is True

    ts = TransferStats()
    ts.bytes_read += 100
    assert ts.bytes_read == 100

    cs = CommandStats()
    assert cs.total_commands == 0
    assert cs.command_counts == {}

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.types import ConsistencyPolicy, MountMode
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def _make_ws(consistency=ConsistencyPolicy.NONE, ttl_seconds=300):
    backend = MemoryBackend()
    backend.put("/file.txt", b"original")
    ws = Workspace(
        {"/data/": backend},
        mode=MountMode.WRITE,
        consistency=consistency,
        ttl_seconds=ttl_seconds,
    )
    return ws, backend


def test_consistency_none_caches_forever():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.NONE)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"


def test_consistency_always_refetches():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.ALWAYS)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"updated"


def test_consistency_ttl_fresh_within_window():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.TTL, ttl_seconds=300)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"


def test_consistency_ttl_stale_after_expiry():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.TTL, ttl_seconds=10)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    entry = ws._cache.get("/data/file.txt")
    entry.cached_at -= 20
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"updated"


def test_consistency_lazy_unchanged():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.LAZY)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"


def test_consistency_lazy_changed():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.LAZY)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated-content"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"updated-content"


def test_dirty_file_skips_revalidation():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.ALWAYS)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"local-edit")
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"remote-change"
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"local-edit"


def test_per_mount_consistency():
    be_none = MemoryBackend()
    be_none.put("/f.txt", b"v1")
    be_always = MemoryBackend()
    be_always.put("/f.txt", b"v1")
    ws = Workspace(
        {
            "/a/": be_none,
            "/b/": (be_always, MountMode.READ, ConsistencyPolicy.ALWAYS),
        },
        mode=MountMode.READ,
        consistency=ConsistencyPolicy.NONE,
    )
    assert ws.cat("/a/f.txt") == b"v1"
    assert ws.cat("/b/f.txt") == b"v1"
    be_none._files["/f.txt"] = b"v2"
    be_none._modified["/f.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    be_always._files["/f.txt"] = b"v2"
    be_always._modified["/f.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/a/f.txt") == b"v1"
    assert ws.cat("/b/f.txt") == b"v2"

import pytest

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.types import MountMode, SyncPolicy
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def _make_ws(mode=MountMode.WRITE, sync_policy=SyncPolicy.STAGED):
    backend = MemoryBackend()
    return Workspace({"/data/": backend}, mode=mode,
                     sync_policy=sync_policy), backend


def test_write_and_cat():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/hello.txt", b"hello world")
    assert ws.cat("/data/hello.txt") == b"hello world"


def test_write_marks_dirty():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"x")
    assert any(i.virtual_path == "/data/file.txt" and i.dirty
               for i in ws.status())


def test_rm_staged_only():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/new.txt", b"staged")
    ws.rm("/data/new.txt")
    assert not ws.exists("/data/new.txt")


def test_rm_persisted():
    ws, backend = _make_ws()
    backend.put("/remote.txt", b"remote")
    ws.rm("/data/remote.txt")
    assert not ws.exists("/data/remote.txt")


def test_mv_staged_only():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/a.txt", b"content")
    ws.mv("/data/a.txt", "/data/b.txt")
    assert ws.cat("/data/b.txt") == b"content"
    assert not ws.exists("/data/a.txt")


def test_cp_creates_copy():
    ws, backend = _make_ws()
    backend.put("/src.txt", b"original")
    ws.cp("/data/src.txt", "/data/copy.txt")
    assert ws.cat("/data/copy.txt") == b"original"


def test_write_read_only_raises():
    ws, _ = _make_ws(mode=MountMode.READ)
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        ws.write("/data/x.txt", b"x")


def test_sync_staged_writes_to_backend():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(sync_policy=SyncPolicy.STAGED)
    ws.write("/data/out.txt", b"synced")
    results = ws.sync()
    assert any(r.path == "/data/out.txt" and r.status == "ok" for r in results)
    assert backend.cat("/out.txt") == b"synced"


def test_sync_immediate_writes_through():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/live.txt", b"live data")
    assert backend.cat("/live.txt") == b"live data"
    assert not any(i.dirty for i in ws.status())


def test_reset_clears_dirty():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/x.txt", b"x")
    ws.reset()
    assert ws.status() == []


def test_stat_staged_file():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/stat.txt", b"hello")
    stat = ws.stat("/data/stat.txt")
    assert stat.size == 5


def test_exists_staged_file():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/exists.txt", b"y")
    assert ws.exists("/data/exists.txt")

import pytest

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.types import MountMode, SyncPolicy
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def test_lock_paths_blocks_write():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
            ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")


def test_lock_paths_unlocks_on_exit():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
        pass
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"world"


def test_lock_paths_unlocks_on_exception():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
            raise RuntimeError("boom")
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"world"


def test_lock_allows_read():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
        assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"hello"


def test_lock_multiple_paths():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/a.txt", b"a")
    ws.write("/data/b.txt", b"b")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/a.txt", "/data/b.txt"]):
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
            ws.write("/data/a.txt", b"x")
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
            ws.write("/data/b.txt", b"x")


def test_unlock_paths_force():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    ws._lock_path("/data/file.txt")
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
        ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")
    ws.unlock_paths(["/data/file.txt"])
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")

Here is a complete, thorough analysis of the workspace module:

---

## 1. `mirage/workspace/__init__.py` - Complete Analysis

**Imports (internal dependencies):**
- `mirage.backend.base.BaseBackend`
- `mirage.backend.filetype.guess_type`
- `mirage.types`: `ConsistencyPolicy`, `FileStat`, `Inode`, `MountMode`, `SyncPolicy`, `SyncResult`, `TransferStats`
- `mirage.workspace.cache.LRUCache`
- `mirage.workspace.cache.policy.is_fresh`
- `mirage.workspace.mount.MountRegistry`
- `mirage.workspace.sync.DirtyTracker`

**Classes defined:**

**`_PathLock`** (private context manager, lines 15-25):
- Wraps a list of locked paths in a context manager
- `__exit__` calls `ws.unlock_paths(paths)`

**`Workspace`** (lines 28-368) - the sole public export:

Constructor parameters:
- `backends: dict[str, BaseBackend | tuple]` — prefix-to-backend map; tuples can be `(backend, mode)` or `(backend, mode, consistency)`
- `cache_limit: str | int = "512MB"`
- `sync_policy: SyncPolicy = SyncPolicy.STAGED`
- `mode: MountMode = MountMode.READ`
- `consistency: ConsistencyPolicy = ConsistencyPolicy.NONE`
- `ttl_seconds: int = 300`

Internal state:
- `_registry: MountRegistry` — handles prefix routing
- `_cache: LRUCache` — in-memory LRU cache
- `_tracker: DirtyTracker` — tracks dirty/staged writes
- `_sync_policy: SyncPolicy`
- `_consistency: ConsistencyPolicy`
- `_ttl_seconds: int`
- `_locked_paths: set[str]`
- `_transfer_stats: dict[str, TransferStats]`
- `_created_at: float`

Method groups:

**Mount management:**
- `mount(prefix, backend, mode, consistency)` — delegates to `_registry.mount()`
- `backend(path) -> BaseBackend` — resolves path to backend

**Read ops:**
- `cat(path) -> bytes` — cache-aware read; checks dirty tracker first, then LRU cache with consistency validation, falls back to backend
- `ls(path) -> list[str]` — merges backend listing with staged (dirty) writes; respects staged deletes
- `ls_l(path) -> list[FileStat]` — delegates directly to backend
- `stat(path) -> FileStat` — uses tracker for staged writes, else backend
- `exists(path) -> bool` — wraps `stat()` catching `FileNotFoundError`/`ValueError`
- `head(path, lines) -> bytes` — delegates to backend
- `tail(path, lines) -> bytes` — delegates to backend
- `read(path, offset, size) -> bytes` — slice read; uses cache for dirty files, else backend
- `grep(pattern, path) -> list[str]` — delegates to backend

**Write ops:**
- `write(path, data)` — caches data, marks dirty in tracker; if `IMMEDIATE` policy, also calls `backend.put()` and clears dirty flag
- `mkdir(path)` — delegates to backend
- `rm(path)` — deletes from backend unless staged-only write; invalidates cache, marks tracker deleted
- `mv(src, dst)` — handles staged-only moves in cache/tracker; same-backend rename via `backend.rename()`; cross-backend via cat+put+unlink
- `cp(src, dst)` — reads via `cat()`, writes via `backend.put()`

**Sync lifecycle:**
- `sync(path=None) -> list[SyncResult]` — flushes all (or one) dirty inodes to their backends via `_tracker.on_sync()`
- `status() -> list[Inode]` — all tracked inodes
- `reset()` — clears tracker and cache

**Path locking:**
- `lock_paths(paths) -> _PathLock` — marks paths locked; returns context manager
- `unlock_paths(paths)` — removes paths from locked set
- `_lock_path(path)` — internal single-path lock
- `_assert_not_locked(path)` — raises `PermissionError` if locked

**Private helpers:**
- `_mount_prefix(path) -> str` — returns the mount prefix string for a path
- `_effective_consistency(path) -> ConsistencyPolicy` — returns per-mount consistency or workspace default
- `_assert_writable(path)` — raises `PermissionError` if mount mode is `READ`
- `_record_transfer(path, op, nbytes, duration_ms, cache_hit)` — accumulates `TransferStats` per mount prefix

---

## 2. `mirage/workspace/mount.py`

**`Mount`** (dataclass-like class):
- Fields: `prefix: str`, `backend: BaseBackend`, `mode: MountMode`, `consistency: ConsistencyPolicy | None`
- Normalizes prefix to always have form `"/stripped/"` (or `"/"` for root)

**`MountRegistry`**:
- Maintains `_mounts: list[Mount]` sorted by prefix length descending (longest-prefix-match)
- `mount(prefix, backend, mode, consistency)` — adds a mount, rejects duplicates, re-sorts
- `resolve(path) -> (backend, backend_path, mode)` — strips the mount prefix from the path, returns backend + stripped path
- `mount_for(path) -> Mount` — returns full `Mount` object for a path
- `mounts() -> list[Mount]` — returns copy of mount list

---

## 3. `mirage/workspace/sync.py`

**`DirtyTracker`**:
- Maintains `_inodes: dict[str, Inode]`
- `on_read(path, data, mount)` — creates or updates inode; sets `dirty=False`, updates checksum and `remote_checksum` to match
- `on_write(path, data, mount)` — creates or updates inode; sets `dirty=True`, updates `checksum`, leaves `remote_checksum` as-is (or `None` for new files)
- `on_delete(path)` — sets `dirty=True`, `checksum=None`, `size=None`
- `on_sync(virtual_path, backend_path, data, backend) -> SyncResult` — uploads (or unlinks for deletions); on success clears `dirty`, updates `remote_checksum`; returns `SyncResult` with op=`"create"/"modify"/"delete"`, status=`"ok"/"error"`
- `dirty() -> list[Inode]` — all inodes where `dirty=True`
- `status() -> list[Inode]` — all tracked inodes
- `get(path) -> Inode | None`
- `reset()` — clears all inodes

**`_md5(data) -> str`** (module-level private): MD5 hex digest for checksums

---

## 4. `mirage/workspace/cache/` files

**`entry.py`** — `CacheEntry(BaseModel)`:
- `data: bytes`
- `cached_at: float` (monotonic timestamp)
- `etag: str | None`
- `modified: str | None`
- `size: int | None`

**`policy.py`**:
- `is_fresh(entry, consistency, ttl_seconds, backend, backend_path) -> (bool, FileStat | None)`:
  - `NONE` → always fresh (returns `True, None`)
  - `ALWAYS` → never fresh (returns `False, None`)
  - `TTL` → fresh if within ttl window; else falls through to metadata check
  - `LAZY` (implicit else) → falls through to metadata check using `backend.stat()`
  - Metadata check does `backend.stat()` and delegates to `metadata_matches()`
- `metadata_matches(entry, remote) -> bool`: prefers etag, then modified timestamp, then size

**`store.py`** — `LRUCache`:
- `_parse_limit(limit)` — parses "512MB", "1GB", etc. to bytes
- `get(path) -> CacheEntry | None` — moves to end (LRU touch)
- `put(path, data, etag, modified, size)` — stores new entry, evicts oldest if over limit
- `invalidate(path)` — removes single entry
- `clear()` — wipes all entries
- Properties: `size`, `limit`
- `_evict()` — pops from front (LRU eviction) until under limit

**`cache/__init__.py`** — exports `CacheEntry` and `LRUCache`

---

## 5. `ConsistencyPolicy` in `mirage/types.py`

```python
class ConsistencyPolicy(str, Enum):
    NONE = "none"      # Always serve from cache; never validate against remote
    LAZY = "lazy"      # Validate cache by comparing metadata (etag/modified/size) with backend.stat()
    TTL = "ttl"        # Serve from cache within TTL window; after expiry, fall through to metadata check
    ALWAYS = "always"  # Never use cache; always re-fetch from backend
```

Used in: `workspace/__init__.py` (constructor, `_effective_consistency`), `mount.py` (per-mount override), `cache/policy.py` (the actual staleness logic).

class ConsistencyPolicy(str, Enum):
    NONE = "none"      # Always serve from cache; never validate against remote
    LAZY = "lazy"      # Validate cache by comparing metadata (etag/modified/size) with backend.stat()
    TTL = "ttl"        # Serve from cache within TTL window; after expiry, fall through to metadata check
    ALWAYS = "always"  # Never use cache; always re-fetch from backend

# Refactor workspace/__init__.py + ConsistencyPolicy cleanup

## Context

`mirage/workspace/__init__.py` contains the entire `Workspace` class (~340 lines) plus a `_PathLock` helper. Every other package in the codebase (`backend/`, `runtime/`, `fuse/`) uses `__init__.py` only for re-exports. This refactor moves the `Workspace` class to its own file and cleans up the confusing `ConsistencyPolicy.NONE` naming.

## Changes

### 1. Rename `ConsistencyPolicy.NONE` → `ConsistencyPolicy.CACHED`

**File: `mirage/types.py`**
- Rename the enum member `NONE = "none"` → `CACHED = "cached"`

**All references** (~14 occurrences across these files):
- `mirage/workspace/__init__.py` (will become `workspace.py`)
- `mirage/workspace/cache/policy.py`
- `mirage/cli/commands/workspace.py`
- `mirage/cli/commands/command.py` (4 occurrences)
- `mirage/cli/config.py`
- `mirage/server/fastapi/config.py`
- `mirage/server/service/local.py`
- `tests/workspace/test_init.py` (will become `test_workspace.py`)
- `tests/cli/test_app.py`
- `tests/cli/test_config.py`

### 2. Make `Mount.consistency` always explicit (never `None`)

**File: `mirage/workspace/mount.py`**
- `Mount.__init__`: Change `consistency: ConsistencyPolicy | None = None` → `consistency: ConsistencyPolicy = ConsistencyPolicy.CACHED`
- `MountRegistry.mount()`: Same signature change

**File: `mirage/workspace/__init__.py` → `workspace.py`**
- In the `backends` dict parsing loop: when no consistency is provided in the tuple, use `self._consistency` (the workspace default) instead of `None`
- `Workspace.mount()`: Change `consistency: ConsistencyPolicy | None = None` → `consistency: ConsistencyPolicy = ConsistencyPolicy.CACHED`
- Remove `_effective_consistency()` method entirely — just use `mount.consistency` directly
- In `cat()`: replace `self._effective_consistency(path)` with `self._registry.mount_for(path).consistency`

**File: `mirage/server/service/local.py`**
- Update mount consistency parsing to use `ConsistencyPolicy.CACHED` instead of `None`

**File: `mirage/server/fastapi/config.py`**
- `MountConfig.consistency: ConsistencyPolicy = ConsistencyPolicy.CACHED` (no more `| None`)

**File: `mirage/cli/commands/workspace.py`**
- Update any `None` defaults for consistency to `ConsistencyPolicy.CACHED`

### 3. Move Workspace class to `workspace/workspace.py`

**Create: `mirage/workspace/workspace.py`**
- Move `_PathLock` class and `Workspace` class from `__init__.py`
- All existing imports stay the same

**Modify: `mirage/workspace/__init__.py`**
- Replace with re-exports only:
```python
from mirage.workspace.workspace import Workspace

__all__ = ["Workspace"]
```

### 4. Rename test file

- `git mv tests/workspace/test_init.py tests/workspace/test_workspace.py`
- No content changes needed (imports stay the same since they import from `mirage.workspace`)

## Execution Order

1. Rename `ConsistencyPolicy.NONE` → `CACHED` in `mirage/types.py`
2. Update all `ConsistencyPolicy.NONE` references across codebase
3. Make `Mount.consistency` non-optional in `mount.py`
4. Move `Workspace` + `_PathLock` to `mirage/workspace/workspace.py`
5. Rewrite `mirage/workspace/__init__.py` as re-exports
6. Remove `_effective_consistency` method, update `cat()` to use mount directly
7. Update workspace init parsing to pass explicit consistency instead of `None`
8. Rename `tests/workspace/test_init.py` → `test_workspace.py`
9. Update server/cli files that used `None` for consistency

## Key Files

- `mirage/types.py` — enum rename
- `mirage/workspace/__init__.py` → slim re-exports
- `mirage/workspace/workspace.py` — new home for Workspace class
- `mirage/workspace/mount.py` — Mount.consistency always explicit
- `mirage/workspace/cache/policy.py` — update NONE → CACHED
- `mirage/cli/commands/workspace.py`, `command.py`, `config.py` — update refs
- `mirage/server/fastapi/config.py`, `mirage/server/service/local.py` — update refs
- `tests/workspace/test_workspace.py` — renamed from test_init.py

## Verification

1. `uv run pytest` — all 641 tests pass
2. `pre-commit run --all-files` — lint/format clean

This plan reorganizes tests so each source file `mirage/a/b/c.py` has exactly one test file `tests/a/b/test_c.py`.

import typer

from mirage.cli.config import split_mount_spec
from mirage.cli.helpers import _client
from mirage.types import ConsistencyPolicy, MountMode, RuntimeType

command_app = typer.Typer(no_args_is_help=True)
command_server_app = typer.Typer(no_args_is_help=True)


@command_app.command(name="add")
def command_add(
        ws_id: str = typer.Argument(),
        name: str = typer.Argument(),
        exec_str: str = typer.Argument(),
        description: str = typer.Option(""),
) -> None:
    """Register a user CLI command in a workspace."""
    _client().register_command(ws_id, name, exec_str, description)
    print(f"registered: {name}")


@command_server_app.command(name="serve")
def command_server_serve(
    mount_specs: list[str] | None = typer.Argument(default=None),
    host: str = typer.Option("0.0.0.0"),
    port: int = typer.Option(8765),
    transport: str = typer.Option("http", help="http or grpc"),
    auth: str = typer.Option("none", help="none, bearer, basic, or apikey"),
    token: str | None = typer.Option(None,
                                     help="Bearer token (--auth bearer)"),
    api_key: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="API key (--auth apikey)"),
    api_key_header: str = typer.Option("X-API-Key"),
    username: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Username (--auth basic)"),
    password: str | None = typer.Option(None, help="Password (--auth basic)"),
    mode: MountMode = typer.Option(MountMode.READ),
    config: str | None = typer.Option(None),
    runtime: RuntimeType = typer.Option(RuntimeType.MEMORY,
                                        help="Runtime: memory or local"),
) -> None:
    """Start a standalone command server backed by the given mounts."""
    from mirage.backend.loader import load_backend_class
    from mirage.cli.config import (load_workspace_yaml, parse_mount_uri,
                                   parse_mount_uri_full)
    from mirage.commands.remote.auth import (APIKeyAuth, BasicAuth,
                                             BearerTokenAuth, NoAuth)
    from mirage.workspace import Workspace

    default_mode = mode
    mounts: dict = {}
    if config:
        cfg = load_workspace_yaml(config)
        if "mounts" in cfg:
            for prefix, value in cfg["mounts"].items():
                if isinstance(value, str):
                    backend_obj, m, _ = parse_mount_uri_full(
                        value, default_mode, ConsistencyPolicy.NONE)
                elif isinstance(value, dict) and "backend" in value:
                    cls = load_backend_class(value["backend"])
                    backend_obj = cls(**(value.get("args") or {}))

import os
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Annotated

import typer

from mirage.backend.loader import load_backend_class
from mirage.cli.client import ClientError
from mirage.cli.config import (load_workspace_yaml, parse_mount_uri,
                               parse_mount_uri_full, split_mount_spec)
from mirage.cli.helpers import _client, _ensure_server
from mirage.fuse.loader import build_registry_from_config
from mirage.fuse.registry import FuseOpRegistry
from mirage.observe.inspector import (workspace_status_from_ws,
                                      workspace_transfers_from_ws)
from mirage.types import ConsistencyPolicy, MountMode, RuntimeType
from mirage.workspace import Workspace

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from mirage.fuse.fs import MirageFS

workspace_app = typer.Typer(no_args_is_help=True)

REPORT_INTERVAL = 2


def _report_loop(ws: Workspace, mountpoint: str, fs: "MirageFS") -> None:
    from mirage.cli.client import MirageClient
    client = MirageClient()
    time.sleep(2)
    while True:
        try:
            status = workspace_status_from_ws(ws)
            transfers = workspace_transfers_from_ws(ws)
            ops = fs.drain_ops()
            client.report_fuse_stats(mountpoint, status, transfers, ops)
        except Exception:
            pass
        time.sleep(REPORT_INTERVAL)


def _parse_mounts_for_fuse(
    specs: list[str],
    cfg: dict,
    default_mode: MountMode,
    default_consistency: ConsistencyPolicy,
    ttl: int,
    agent_id: str | None,
) -> tuple[dict, MountMode, ConsistencyPolicy, int, str | None]:
    resolved_agent_id = agent_id
    mounts: dict = {}
    if cfg:
        if "consistency" in cfg:
            default_consistency = ConsistencyPolicy(cfg["consistency"])
        if "ttl" in cfg:
            ttl = cfg["ttl"]
        if not resolved_agent_id and "agent_id" in cfg:
            resolved_agent_id = cfg["agent_id"]
        for prefix, value in cfg.get("mounts", {}).items():
            if isinstance(value, str):
                backend_obj, m, c = parse_mount_uri_full(
                    value, default_mode, default_consistency)
            elif isinstance(value, dict) and "backend" in value:
                cls = load_backend_class(value["backend"])
                backend_obj = cls(**(value.get("args") or {}))
                m = (MountMode(value["mode"])
                     if "mode" in value else default_mode)
                c = (ConsistencyPolicy(value["consistency"])
                     if "consistency" in value else default_consistency)
            elif isinstance(value, dict):
                backend_obj = parse_mount_uri(value.get("uri", ""))
                m = (MountMode(value["mode"])
                     if "mode" in value else default_mode)
                c = (ConsistencyPolicy(value["consistency"])
                     if "consistency" in value else default_consistency)
            else:
                continue
            has_override = (m != default_mode or c != default_consistency)
            if has_override:
                mounts[prefix] = (backend_obj, m, c)
            else:
                mounts[prefix] = backend_obj
    for spec in specs:
        uri, prefix = split_mount_spec(spec)
        backend_obj, m, c = parse_mount_uri_full(uri, default_mode,
                                                 default_consistency)
        has_override = (m != default_mode or c != default_consistency)
        if has_override:
            mounts[prefix] = (backend_obj, m, c)
        else:
            mounts[prefix] = backend_obj
    return mounts, default_mode, default_consistency, ttl, resolved_agent_id


def mount(
    mount_specs: Annotated[
        list[str] | None,
        typer.Argument(help="Mount specs: backend:/path "
                       "(e.g. memory:/data/, s3://bucket:/). "
                       "Append #none|#lazy|#ttl|#always for "
                       "consistency, @read|@write|@exec for mode.")] = None,
    sync_policy: str = typer.Option("staged", help="staged or immediate"),
    mode: MountMode = typer.Option(MountMode.WRITE, help="read or write"),
    consistency: ConsistencyPolicy = typer.Option(ConsistencyPolicy.NONE),
    ttl: int = typer.Option(300, help="TTL in seconds for ttl consistency"),
    config: str | None = typer.Option(None,
                                      help="Path to YAML workspace config"),
    runtime: RuntimeType = typer.Option(RuntimeType.MEMORY,
                                        help="Runtime: memory or local"),
    fuse: bool = typer.Option(False, help="Also mount as FUSE filesystem"),
    mountpoint: str | None = typer.Option(
        None, help="Local directory for FUSE mount (requires --fuse)"),
    agent_id: str | None = typer.Option(
        None, help="Agent identity exposed via /.mirage/whoami"),
    backend: str | None = typer.Option(
        None,
        help="Backend URI mounted at /. Prefix specs override for subtree."),
) -> None:
    """Create a workspace and mount backends.

    Each backend URI is routed by prefix. The longest matching prefix wins,
    so /data/logs/ takes priority over /data/ for paths under /data/logs/.

    With --fuse, also mounts the workspace as a local FUSE filesystem
    (requires macFUSE / libfuse). The process blocks while FUSE is mounted.

    URI formats:
      memory             in-memory (no disk, no deps)
      local              local filesystem at current directory
      local:./path       local filesystem at ./path (converted to abs)
      s3://bucket/pfx    AWS S3  (requires mirage[s3])
      r2://account/bkt   Cloudflare R2  (requires mirage[s3])
      https://host       HTTP read-only (requires mirage[http])
    """
    specs = list(mount_specs or [])
    if backend:
        specs.insert(0, f"{backend}:/")

    if fuse:
        _mount_fuse(specs, config, mode, consistency, ttl, agent_id,
                    mountpoint, runtime)
        return

    _ensure_server()
    mounts: dict[str, str | dict] = {}
    if config:
        cfg = load_workspace_yaml(config)
        mounts.update(cfg.get("mounts", {}))
        consistency_str = cfg.get("consistency")
        if consistency_str:
            consistency = ConsistencyPolicy(consistency_str)
        ttl = cfg.get("ttl", ttl)
    consistency_suffixes = ("#none", "#lazy", "#ttl", "#always")
    for spec in specs:
        try:
            uri, prefix = split_mount_spec(spec)
        except ValueError as e:
            raise typer.BadParameter(str(e))
        mount_consistency = None
        for suffix in consistency_suffixes:
            if uri.endswith(suffix):
                mount_consistency = suffix[1:]
                uri = uri[:-len(suffix)]
                break
        mount_mode = None
        for suffix in ("@read", "@write", "@exec"):
            if uri.endswith(suffix):
                mount_mode = suffix[1:]
                uri = uri[:-len(suffix)]
                break
        entry: dict[str, str] = {"uri": uri}
        if mount_mode:
            entry["mode"] = mount_mode
        if mount_consistency:
            entry["consistency"] = mount_consistency
        if len(entry) == 1:
            mounts[prefix] = uri
        else:
            mounts[prefix] = entry
    ws_id = _client().create_workspace(
        mounts,
        sync_policy=sync_policy,
        mode=mode.value,
        consistency=consistency.value,
        ttl_seconds=ttl,
        runtime=runtime.value,
    )
    print(ws_id)


def _mount_fuse(
    specs: list[str],
    config: str | None,
    mode: MountMode,
    consistency: ConsistencyPolicy,
    ttl: int,
    agent_id: str | None,
    mountpoint: str | None,
    runtime: RuntimeType,
) -> None:
    from mirage.backend.network.proxy import ProxyBackend
    from mirage.fuse.fs import MirageFS
    from mirage.fuse.fs import mount as fuse_mount_fn
    from mirage.fuse.remote.remote import RemoteFuseOp

    if not mountpoint:
        raise typer.BadParameter("--mountpoint is required when using --fuse")
    if not specs and not config:
        raise typer.BadParameter(
            "No backends specified. Use --backend URI or provide mount specs.")
    for spec in specs:
        if ":" not in spec:
            raise typer.BadParameter(
                f"Invalid mount spec: {spec!r}. Use backend:/path")

    Path(mountpoint).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _ensure_server()
    cfg = load_workspace_yaml(config) if config else {}

    if runtime == RuntimeType.REMOTE:
        url = cfg.get("url", "")
        ws_id_remote = cfg.get("ws_id", "")
        proxy = ProxyBackend(url, ws_id_remote)
        ws = Workspace({"/": proxy}, mode=MountMode.WRITE)
        fuse_registry = FuseOpRegistry()
        fuse_registry.set_default(RemoteFuseOp(proxy))
        fs = MirageFS(ws, agent_id=agent_id, fuse_registry=fuse_registry)
    else:
        mounts, mode, consistency, ttl, agent_id = _parse_mounts_for_fuse(
            specs, cfg, mode, consistency, ttl, agent_id)
        ws = Workspace(mounts,
                       mode=mode,
                       consistency=consistency,
                       ttl_seconds=ttl)
        fuse_ops_config = cfg.get("fuse_ops", {}) if cfg else {}
        fuse_registry = build_registry_from_config(fuse_ops_config)
        fs = MirageFS(ws, agent_id=agent_id, fuse_registry=fuse_registry)

    pid = os.getpid()
    _client().register_fuse(mountpoint, pid, specs, runtime=runtime.value)

    thread = threading.Thread(target=_report_loop,
                              args=(ws, mountpoint, fs),
                              daemon=True)
    thread.start()

    fuse_mount_fn(mountpoint=mountpoint, foreground=True, fs=fs)


def exec_cmd(
        ws_id: str = typer.Argument(),
        command: list[str] = typer.Argument(),
) -> None:
    """Execute a command in a running workspace."""
    cmd_str = " ".join(command)
    try:
        output = _client().exec(ws_id, cmd_str)
        if output:
            print(output)
    except ClientError as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

    try:

                marker = "D" if i["dirty"] else " "
                print(f"{marker} {i['path']}")

    except ClientError as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from mirage.backend.local.memory import MemoryBackend
from mirage.types import ConsistencyPolicy, MountMode, SyncPolicy
from mirage.workspace import Workspace


def _make_consistency_ws(consistency=ConsistencyPolicy.NONE, ttl_seconds=300):
    backend = MemoryBackend()
    backend.put("/file.txt", b"original")
    ws = Workspace(
        {"/data/": backend},
        mode=MountMode.WRITE,
        consistency=consistency,
        ttl_seconds=ttl_seconds,
    )
    return ws, backend


def _make_ws(mode=MountMode.WRITE, sync_policy=SyncPolicy.STAGED):
    backend = MemoryBackend()
    return Workspace({"/data/": backend}, mode=mode,
                     sync_policy=sync_policy), backend


def test_consistency_none_caches_forever():
    ws, backend = _make_consistency_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.NONE)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"


def test_consistency_always_refetches():
    ws, backend = _make_consistency_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.ALWAYS)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"updated"


def test_consistency_ttl_fresh_within_window():
    ws, backend = _make_consistency_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.TTL, ttl_seconds=300)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"


def test_consistency_ttl_stale_after_expiry():
    ws, backend = _make_consistency_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.TTL, ttl_seconds=10)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    entry = ws._cache.get("/data/file.txt")
    entry.cached_at -= 20
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"updated"


def test_consistency_lazy_unchanged():
    ws, backend = _make_consistency_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.LAZY)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"


def test_consistency_lazy_changed():
    ws, backend = _make_consistency_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.LAZY)
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"original"
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"updated-content"
    backend._modified["/file.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"updated-content"


def test_dirty_file_skips_revalidation():
    ws, backend = _make_consistency_ws(ConsistencyPolicy.ALWAYS)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"local-edit")
    backend._files["/file.txt"] = b"remote-change"
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"local-edit"


def test_per_mount_consistency():
    be_none = MemoryBackend()
    be_none.put("/f.txt", b"v1")
    be_always = MemoryBackend()
    be_always.put("/f.txt", b"v1")
    ws = Workspace(
        {
            "/a/": be_none,
            "/b/": (be_always, MountMode.READ, ConsistencyPolicy.ALWAYS),
        },
        mode=MountMode.READ,
        consistency=ConsistencyPolicy.NONE,
    )
    assert ws.cat("/a/f.txt") == b"v1"
    assert ws.cat("/b/f.txt") == b"v1"
    be_none._files["/f.txt"] = b"v2"
    be_none._modified["/f.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    be_always._files["/f.txt"] = b"v2"
    be_always._modified["/f.txt"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    assert ws.cat("/a/f.txt") == b"v1"
    assert ws.cat("/b/f.txt") == b"v2"


def test_write_and_cat():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/hello.txt", b"hello world")
    assert ws.cat("/data/hello.txt") == b"hello world"


def test_write_marks_dirty():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"x")
    assert any(i.virtual_path == "/data/file.txt" and i.dirty
               for i in ws.status())


def test_rm_staged_only():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/new.txt", b"staged")
    ws.rm("/data/new.txt")
    assert not ws.exists("/data/new.txt")


def test_rm_persisted():
    ws, backend = _make_ws()
    backend.put("/remote.txt", b"remote")
    ws.rm("/data/remote.txt")
    assert not ws.exists("/data/remote.txt")


def test_mv_staged_only():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/a.txt", b"content")
    ws.mv("/data/a.txt", "/data/b.txt")
    assert ws.cat("/data/b.txt") == b"content"
    assert not ws.exists("/data/a.txt")


def test_cp_creates_copy():
    ws, backend = _make_ws()
    backend.put("/src.txt", b"original")
    ws.cp("/data/src.txt", "/data/copy.txt")
    assert ws.cat("/data/copy.txt") == b"original"


def test_write_read_only_raises():
    ws, _ = _make_ws(mode=MountMode.READ)
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        ws.write("/data/x.txt", b"x")


def test_sync_staged_writes_to_backend():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(sync_policy=SyncPolicy.STAGED)
    ws.write("/data/out.txt", b"synced")
    results = ws.sync()
    assert any(r.path == "/data/out.txt" and r.status == "ok" for r in results)
    assert backend.cat("/out.txt") == b"synced"


def test_sync_immediate_writes_through():
    ws, backend = _make_ws(sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/live.txt", b"live data")
    assert backend.cat("/live.txt") == b"live data"
    assert not any(i.dirty for i in ws.status())


def test_reset_clears_dirty():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/x.txt", b"x")
    ws.reset()
    assert ws.status() == []


def test_stat_staged_file():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/stat.txt", b"hello")
    stat = ws.stat("/data/stat.txt")
    assert stat.size == 5


def test_exists_staged_file():
    ws, _ = _make_ws()
    ws.write("/data/exists.txt", b"y")
    assert ws.exists("/data/exists.txt")


def test_lock_paths_blocks_write():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
            ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")


def test_lock_paths_unlocks_on_exit():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
        pass
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"world"


def test_lock_paths_unlocks_on_exception():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError):
        with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
            raise RuntimeError("boom")
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")
    assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"world"


def test_lock_allows_read():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/file.txt"]):
        assert ws.cat("/data/file.txt") == b"hello"


def test_lock_multiple_paths():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/a.txt", b"a")
    ws.write("/data/b.txt", b"b")
    with ws.lock_paths(["/data/a.txt", "/data/b.txt"]):
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
            ws.write("/data/a.txt", b"x")
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
            ws.write("/data/b.txt", b"x")


def test_unlock_paths_force():
    ws = Workspace({"/data/": MemoryBackend()},
                   mode=MountMode.WRITE,
                   sync_policy=SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE)
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"hello")
    ws._lock_path("/data/file.txt")
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError, match="locked"):
        ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")
    ws.unlock_paths(["/data/file.txt"])
    ws.write("/data/file.txt", b"world")

from __future__ import annotations

import time

from mirage.backend.base import BaseBackend
from mirage.backend.filetype import guess_type
from mirage.types import (ConsistencyPolicy, FileStat, Inode, MountMode,
                          SyncPolicy, SyncResult, TransferStats)
from mirage.workspace.cache import LRUCache
from mirage.workspace.cache.policy import is_fresh
from mirage.workspace.mount import MountRegistry
from mirage.workspace.sync import DirtyTracker


class _PathLock:

    def __init__(self, ws: Workspace, paths: list[str]) -> None:
        self._ws = ws
        self._paths = paths

    def __enter__(self) -> _PathLock:
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_: object) -> None:
        self._ws.unlock_paths(self._paths)


class Workspace:
    """
    Unified virtual filesystem over heterogeneous backends.

    Mounts backends at virtual path prefixes and provides a command-level API
    (cat, ls, write, cp, mv, rm, ...) with transparent caching
    and write staging.

    Example::

        ws = Workspace(
            {"/data/": S3Backend(S3Config(bucket="my-bucket")),
             "/tmp/":  MemoryBackend()},
            cache_limit="256MB",
            sync_policy=SyncPolicy.STAGED,
        )
        content = ws.cat("/data/reports/q1.json")
        ws.write("/tmp/summary.txt", b"hello")
        ws.sync()
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        backends: dict[str, BaseBackend | tuple],
        cache_limit: str | int = "512MB",
        sync_policy: SyncPolicy = SyncPolicy.STAGED,
        mode: MountMode = MountMode.READ,
        consistency: ConsistencyPolicy = ConsistencyPolicy.NONE,
        ttl_seconds: int = 300,
    ) -> None:
        self._registry = MountRegistry()
        self._cache = LRUCache(cache_limit)
        self._tracker = DirtyTracker()
        self._sync_policy = sync_policy
        self._consistency = consistency
        self._ttl_seconds = ttl_seconds
        self._locked_paths: set[str] = set()
        self._transfer_stats: dict[str, TransferStats] = {}
        self._created_at: float = time.monotonic()

        for prefix, value in backends.items():
            if isinstance(value, tuple) and len(value) == 3:
                backend, mount_mode, mount_consistency = value
            elif isinstance(value, tuple):
                backend, mount_mode = value
                mount_consistency = None
            else:
                backend = value
                mount_mode = mode
                mount_consistency = None
            self._registry.mount(prefix, backend, mount_mode,
                                 mount_consistency)

    # ── mount management ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def mount(self,
              prefix: str,
              backend: BaseBackend,
              mode: MountMode = MountMode.READ,
              consistency: ConsistencyPolicy | None = None) -> None:
        self._registry.mount(prefix, backend, mode, consistency)

    def backend(self, path: str) -> BaseBackend:
        backend, _, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        return backend

    # ── read ops ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def cat(self, path: str) -> bytes:
        inode = self._tracker.get(path)
        if inode and inode.dirty:
            entry = self._cache.get(path)
            if entry is not None:
                self._record_transfer(path,
                                      "read",
                                      len(entry.data),
                                      0,
                                      cache_hit=True)
                return entry.data

        entry = self._cache.get(path)
        remote_stat = None
        if entry is not None:
            consistency = self._effective_consistency(path)
            backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
            fresh, remote_stat = is_fresh(entry, consistency,
                                          self._ttl_seconds, backend, bp)
            if fresh:
                self._record_transfer(path,
                                      "read",
                                      len(entry.data),
                                      0,
                                      cache_hit=True)
                return entry.data
        else:
            backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)

        t0 = time.monotonic()
        data = backend.cat(bp)
        duration_ms = int((time.monotonic() - t0) * 1000)
        self._record_transfer(path,
                              "read",
                              len(data),
                              duration_ms,
                              cache_hit=False)
        if remote_stat is None:
            remote_stat = backend.stat(bp)
        self._cache.put(path,
                        data,
                        etag=remote_stat.extra.get("etag"),
                        modified=remote_stat.modified,
                        size=remote_stat.size)
        self._tracker.on_read(path, data, self._mount_prefix(path))
        return data

    def ls(self, path: str) -> list[str]:
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        prefix = self._mount_prefix(path).rstrip("/")
        backend_ok = False
        try:
            backend_entries = backend.ls(bp)
            backend_ok = True
        except FileNotFoundError:
            backend_entries = []
        result: set[str] = {
            prefix + "/" + e.lstrip("/")
            for e in backend_entries
        }
        norm_path = "/" + path.strip("/")
        dir_prefix = norm_path.rstrip("/") + "/"
        has_staged_children = False
        for inode in self._tracker.dirty():
            vp = inode.virtual_path
            if not vp.startswith(dir_prefix):
                continue
            if inode.checksum is None:
                result.discard(vp)
                continue
            has_staged_children = True
            remainder = vp[len(dir_prefix):]
            first = remainder.split("/")[0]
            if not first:
                continue
            if "/" in remainder:
                result.add(dir_prefix + first + "/")
            else:
                result.add(dir_prefix + first)
        if not backend_ok and not has_staged_children:
            raise FileNotFoundError(path)
        return sorted(result)

    def ls_l(self, path: str) -> list[FileStat]:
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        return backend.ls_l(bp)

    def stat(self, path: str) -> FileStat:
        # For staged writes, build FileStat from the tracker rather than
        # hitting the backend (which hasn't received the write yet).
        inode = self._tracker.get(path)
        if inode and inode.dirty and inode.checksum is not None:
            entry = self._cache.get(path)
            size = len(entry.data) if entry is not None else inode.size
            return FileStat(
                name=path.rstrip("/").rsplit("/", 1)[-1],
                size=size,
                type=guess_type(path),
            )
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        return backend.stat(bp)

    def exists(self, path: str) -> bool:
        try:
            self.stat(path)
            return True
        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError):
            return False

    def head(self, path: str, lines: int = 10) -> bytes:
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        return backend.head(bp, lines)

    def tail(self, path: str, lines: int = 10) -> bytes:
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        return backend.tail(bp, lines)

    def read(self, path: str, offset: int, size: int) -> bytes:
        inode = self._tracker.get(path)
        if inode and inode.dirty:
            entry = self._cache.get(path)
            if entry is not None:
                return entry.data[offset:offset + size]
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        return backend.read(bp, offset, size)

    def grep(self, pattern: str, path: str) -> list[str]:
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        return backend.grep(pattern, bp)

    # ── write ops ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def write(self, path: str, data: bytes) -> None:
        self._assert_not_locked(path)
        self._assert_writable(path)
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        self._cache.put(path, data)
        self._tracker.on_write(path, data, self._mount_prefix(path))
        self._record_transfer(path, "write", len(data), 0)
        if self._sync_policy == SyncPolicy.IMMEDIATE:
            backend.put(bp, data)
            self._tracker.on_read(path, data, self._mount_prefix(path))

    def mkdir(self, path: str) -> None:
        self._assert_writable(path)
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        backend.mkdir(bp)

    def rm(self, path: str) -> None:
        self._assert_writable(path)
        backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(path)
        inode = self._tracker.get(path)
        staged_only = inode and inode.dirty and inode.remote_checksum is None
        if not staged_only:
            backend.unlink(bp)
        self._cache.invalidate(path)
        self._tracker.on_delete(path)

    def mv(self, src: str, dst: str) -> None:
        self._assert_writable(src)
        sb, sbp, _ = self._registry.resolve(src)
        db, dbp, _ = self._registry.resolve(dst)
        src_inode = self._tracker.get(src)
        staged_only = (src_inode and src_inode.dirty
                       and src_inode.remote_checksum is None)
        if staged_only:
            entry = self._cache.get(src)
            data = entry.data if entry else b""
            self._cache.put(dst, data)
            self._tracker.on_write(dst, data, self._mount_prefix(dst))
            self._cache.invalidate(src)
            self._tracker.on_delete(src)
        elif sb is db:
            sb.rename(sbp, dbp)
            self._cache.invalidate(src)
        else:
            data = sb.cat(sbp)
            db.put(dbp, data)
            sb.unlink(sbp)
            self._cache.invalidate(src)

    def cp(self, src: str, dst: str) -> None:
        self._assert_writable(dst)
        data = self.cat(src)
        db, dbp, _ = self._registry.resolve(dst)
        db.put(dbp, data)

    # ── sync lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def sync(self, path: str | None = None) -> list[SyncResult]:
        results: list[SyncResult] = []
        targets = [
            i for i in self._tracker.dirty()
            if path is None or i.virtual_path == path
        ]
        for inode in targets:
            backend, bp, _ = self._registry.resolve(inode.virtual_path)
            entry = self._cache.get(inode.virtual_path)
            data = entry.data if entry else None
            result = self._tracker.on_sync(inode.virtual_path, bp, data,
                                           backend)
            results.append(result)
        return results

    def status(self) -> list[Inode]:
        return self._tracker.status()

    def reset(self) -> None:
        self._tracker.reset()
        self._cache.clear()

    # ── path locking ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _lock_path(self, path: str) -> None:
        self._locked_paths.add(path)

    def unlock_paths(self, paths: list[str]) -> None:
        for p in paths:
            self._locked_paths.discard(p)

    def lock_paths(self, paths: list[str]) -> _PathLock:
        for p in paths:
            self._lock_path(p)
        return _PathLock(self, paths)

    def _assert_not_locked(self, path: str) -> None:
        if path in self._locked_paths:
            raise PermissionError(
                f"path {path!r} is locked by remote execution")

    # ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _mount_prefix(self, path: str) -> str:
        norm = "/" + path.strip("/")
        for m in self._registry.mounts():
            if norm == m.prefix.rstrip("/") or norm.startswith(m.prefix):
                return m.prefix
        return "/"

    def _effective_consistency(self, path: str) -> ConsistencyPolicy:
        mount = self._registry.mount_for(path)
        if mount.consistency is not None:
            return mount.consistency
        return self._consistency

    def _assert_writable(self, path: str) -> None:
        _, _, mode = self._registry.resolve(path)
        if mode == MountMode.READ:
            raise PermissionError(f"mount at {path!r} is read-only")

    def _record_transfer(self,
                         path: str,
                         op: str,
                         nbytes: int,
                         duration_ms: int,
                         cache_hit: bool | None = None) -> None:
        prefix = self._mount_prefix(path)
        if prefix not in self._transfer_stats:
            self._transfer_stats[prefix] = TransferStats()
        stats = self._transfer_stats[prefix]
        if op == "read":
            stats.bytes_read += nbytes
            stats.read_ops += 1
            stats.total_read_ms += duration_ms
            if cache_hit is True:
                stats.cache_hits += 1
            elif cache_hit is False:
                stats.cache_misses += 1
        elif op == "write":
            stats.bytes_written += nbytes
            stats.write_ops += 1
            stats.total_write_ms += duration_ms
